mapper.select: SELECT id, name, color, sort_order, 0 AS character_count FROM character_tag WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.color, t.sort_order, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS character_count FROM character_tag t LEFT JOIN character_tag_relation r ON r.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN app_character c ON c.id = r.character_id AND c.is_public = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.color, t.sort_order ORDER BY character_count DESC, t.sort_order ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, name, color, sort_order, 0 AS character_count FROM character_tag WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND name IN
#{name}

INSERT INTO character_tag (name, color, sort_order, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{color}, #{sortOrder}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_deleted = 0 RETURNING id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM character_tag WHERE is_deleted = 0
